We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of the molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Likely need to get 1H NMR to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string? Actually function signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return spectra for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then analyze peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm. Count distinct methyl environments. Could also use carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Then count distinct signals. Use both.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
